summary: The account cases detect a wrong shell record and a hash minted for another password

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make utils build/tests/cases/machine/account_scenario && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} utils/sbin/adduser && cp build/tests/cases/machine/account_scenario ${WORK}/account_scenario
exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run account "run: account: PASS"

faults.name: shell-record
faults.summary: adduser writes another available shell in the account record

faults.name: http-password
faults.summary: the real arc gives httpd a password other than the one its client offers
